regime_context: US thematic leadership is concentrated in the memory/HBM & storage complex (rank 1, durability 0.5, crowded, eligible) with AI-infrastructure as a close challenger; 20 of 49 themes are eligible but rotation breadth is flagged 'narrowing' and directional=false, i.e. no confirmed handoff. The only validated leg is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), so I default to low conviction and express everything as checkable conditionals.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the rotation board flips from 'narrowing' to a confirmed handoff: observing AI Infrastructure (rank 2) actually overtaking Memory, HBM & Storage (rank 1) in score while Memory's breadth stays at 0 — that observed overtake would retire this watch and signal a potential leadership change (no directional call implied).

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The theme leads the rotation board (rank 1, score 2.415), carries a high durability bar (0.5) with a 'trend' Hurst tag and qualifies via the absolute-trend gate. Leadership concentration supports keeping exposure, but crowding (crowding_z 1.17, crowded=true) and zero breadth make this a size-down caution, not a momentum buy — the lean is directional only because the validated trend discipline is positive.
evidence: gate_helps=true (absolute-trend gate is the validated risk-control leg)
crowding_z=1.17, crowded=true (sizing caution only, per guardrails not a fade)
theses.dissent: Breadth of 0.0 means the rally is a narrow, single-story move; a crowded, non-broad trend is exactly the kind that mean-reverts sharply if the HBM pricing cycle turns, and cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0 so the high score carries no forward-return information.

falsifier.text: SMH (proxy shared with adjacent semi themes) breaks its own absolute-trend gate before the check-by date, or Memory/HBM lags AI Infrastructure by a widening margin while the theme's breadth stays at 0

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Rank 2 and eligible, with the highest non-crowded durability bar (0.51) among the leaders; it is the only top-3 name that is NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.64). This is a cleaner stay in the AI complex, supported by the validated trend gate rather than by the momentum rank itself.
evidence: crowding_z=0.64, crowded=false (cleaner than memory_storage and semicap_equipment)
challenger to leader in rotation.leader/challenger structure
theses.dissent: Shared proxy SMH makes this hard to isolate from the crowded memory/equipment stories, and 'mixed' Hurst plus a modest durability bar means the trend is not as established as memory_storage's.

falsifier.text: AI Infrastructure fades from rank 2 to below the top 5 while its breadth does not expand, or SMH lags SPY by a material margin before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Rank 6 with a positive score (0.902) but NOT eligible (eligible=false) and Hurst-tagged 'mean-revert' with a very low durability bar (0.12). Because the only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate, and this theme fails that gate, the detector argues for no directional exposure even though the score is positive.
evidence: score 0.902 but rank 6 and failing the trend gate
gate_helps=true — the trend discipline is the only validated leg, and Silver Miners fails it
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting names can bounce hard off low crowding (crowding_z -0.05) especially in a macro surprise tape (unscheduled_share=1.0), and the negative momentum screen says nothing about a sharp reflexive rally.

falsifier.text: SIL clears its own absolute-trend gate and posts a new high before the check-by date, flipping eligible=true

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
